title: Coast Guard Rescues Two Distressed Mariners Near Fire Island, N.Y.
description: Coast Guard Air Station Atlantic City crew rescue two mariners in distress near Fire Island Inlet, New York, Oct. 9, 2015. No injuries were reported and both mariners were successfully removed from the vessel and transported to Coast Guard Station Fire Island. (U.S. Coast Guard video courtesy of Coast Guard Air Station Atlantic City.)

unit_name: U.S. Coast Guard PADET New York
